label: Bible Study
prompt: I waited _____ for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verse: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
note: The waiting came first; the new song came a couple verses later.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy _____, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verse: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
note: A widow's single pot of oil filled every borrowed vessel — enough to pay the debt and live on the rest.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a _____, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verse: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
note: Babel's builders wanted a tower reaching heaven and a name for themselves — God came down to see it.

label: Deep Water
note: Four words, one picture: the Spirit as a fire you can smother — so don't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without _____.
verse: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
note: Proverbs' most memorable image: beauty without 'discretion' is a gold ring in a pig's snout.
